posts.text: I've travelled to nearly 50 countries and have concluded that governments are typically a poor representation of the general population. Even in supposed democracies.
My X audience. 💜
False accusations should carry a much greater social penalty than they currently do.

You could lower crime rates by 80-90% in most places by locking up repeat offenders and keeping them locked up. Or deporting them if they're not citizens. 

A very small % of the population does virtually all the serious crime. Perhaps 1-2% of all people.

See El Salvador, Japan, Gulf countries, Singapore...
It genuinely pains me to see great places slowly destroying themselves through terrible policies and bad leadership.

Good times... 2021.


🇦🇪 HGS (@Sajwani)

Because he wrote to someone “Ok Dude …”

🤣



— https://nitter.net/Sajwani/status/2039731962936803405#m

Every Western country and city needs to adopt tough on crime policies.

Zero tolerance for theft and violent crime.

This is so obvious, yet there is so much resistance.
Some good questions. 💜

Ask me anything for the next 20 minutes. I'll answer the good questions that I see.

Go.

Everybody trades freedom for safety to some degree. Absolute 'freedom' does not exist in any country and nobody would want it to in practice. If you think you are 'free', stop paying taxes and see what happens to you.


Mike Mkrodik (@mkrodik)

Sounds like you trade freedom for safety



— https://nitter.net/mkrodik/status/2039728789706412406#m
It's crazy how people think giving 30-60% of all the money they earn to the government is acceptable.

Which large US city is safer than Dubai right now?

This is a serious question. If it exists, it should be easy to point out.


TexasChris (@greenerytx)

100% no true.



— https://nitter.net/greenerytx/status/2039723928617423192#m
I'd like the bombing to stop, obviously. But facts are facts.

Dubai with missiles and drones is still infinitely safer then any large US city. Statistical fact.


Thomas Rossini (@TheTomRossini)

So being bombed from overhead isn’t so bad huh? 🙄



— https://nitter.net/TheTomRossini/status/2039708756506800404#m
